description: This file defines the UserService class, which handles user registration and login processes, including validation, password hashing, and token generation in a backend service.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Provides methods for user registration, login, and retrieval by ID, encapsulating the core user authentication logic.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new user by validating the username and email, hashing the password, and persisting the user to the database.

methods.name: LoginAsync
methods.description: Authenticates a user using username or email and password, and returns an authentication response with a token.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique identifier.
